name: Arenal and La Fortuna
tagline: A perfect volcano cone above hot springs, waterfalls, hanging bridges and rainforest.
highlight: Soaking in a warm river as the Arenal volcano towers overhead.
shortDescription: An adventure hub at the foot of Arenal Volcano, with La Fortuna Waterfall, natural hot springs, hanging bridges, Lake Arenal and wildlife.
metaDescription: An Arenal and La Fortuna guide: Arenal Volcano National Park, La Fortuna Waterfall, hot springs, hanging bridges, Lake Arenal, canyoning, where to stay, costs and a three-day plan.
nearestAirport: San Jose (SJO), about 3 hours by road; Liberia (LIR), about 2.5 hours

image.alt: The conical Arenal volcano rising above the rainforest

intro: Arenal is Costa Rica's most famous volcano, a near-perfect cone that rises above Lake Arenal and the surrounding rainforest. It was highly active until 2010, and is now quiet, though it remains an impressive sight, especially from the lakeshore or from hanging bridges in the forest.

The nearby town of La Fortuna is the main base, packed with restaurants, tour operators and hotels. Within a short drive you will find the 70-metre La Fortuna Waterfall, volcano-heated hot springs in resorts and natural rivers, hanging-bridge trails through the canopy, white-water rafting, canyoning and horse riding.

The area is also good for wildlife, with sloths, toucans and howler monkeys common, and chocolate and coffee farms offer tours. It is a very touristy area, but the setting is beautiful. Two or three days is enough for the main sights.
